## Summary

- Reorders loop-variable substitution in `PartitionLoop`.
- Simplifies buffer indices before substitution.
- Adds regression tests for parallel loops with `let` indices when let inlining is disabled.
- Adds CUDA/HIP coverage for conditional parallel-loop execution.

## Testing

- Tests were added, but execution results are unavailable.

## C++ style / lint notes

- The PR changes C++ implementation code.
- It does not change `docs/developer_guide/cpp_style.md` or CI configuration.
- The “C++ API Style Audit (warning only)” step remains unchanged.
- No new style warnings were supplied.
